sources.text:
Bükk National Park (Hungarian: Bükki Nemzeti Park) is a national park in the Bükk Mountains of Northern Hungary, near Miskolc. It was founded in 1977 as the third national park in the country. It contains 431.3 km2 (of which 37.74 km2 is under increased protection). Mountainous and forested, Bükk is Hungary's largest national park and is situated in the northern mountains, between Szilvásvárad and Lillafüred. Bükk's important geological features include various karst formations within its limestone mountains - particularly caves (once inhabited by pre-historic people), swallow-holes, and ravines. The country's longest (4,000 metres) and deepest (245 metres) cave, Istvánlápa, is located in the park. Bükk National Park also contains ninety species of nesting birds, some considered endangered.
The Vatican Climate Forest was to be located within the Park. KlimaFa ("Climate Trees") was started by a San Francisco promoter, Russ George, who promised a carbon offsetting project, intended to offset the Vatican's carbon dioxide emissions. stops.name: Bükk National Park
stops.detail: Bükk National Park ist ein Nationalpark im Bükk-Gebirge Nordungarns in der Nähe von Miskolc. Es wurde 1977 als dritter Nationalpark des Landes gegründet. Es enthält 431,3 km2 . Gebirgs- und bewaldet, Bükk ist Ungarns größter Nationalpark und liegt in den nördlichen Bergen, zwischen Szilvásvárad und Lillafüred. Bükks wichtige geologische Merkmale umfassen verschiedene Karstformationen innerhalb seiner Kalksteinberge - insbesondere Höhlen, Schwalben und Schluchten. Die längste und tiefste Höhle des Landes, Istvánlápa, befindet sich im Park. Bükk National Park enthält auch neunzig Arten von Brutvögeln, von denen einige als gefährdet gelten.
